title: Inside Relève
sub: Everything a new member of the team needs to know about Relève: who we serve, how we stand out, how a placement runs from the first call to the second year, and how we sell. Read it in order. It saves as you go.
time: About two and a half hours
parts: Who we are, and why Relève exists
Who we serve, and how we stand out
The plans, the terms, and the path between them
From the first call to a placement that lasts
Our voice, our leads, the call, objections
